snippet.title: ICARUS - Console Edition Announcement | Galaxies Autumn 2025 Showcase
snippet.description:
Drop in to ICARUS like never before — the console edition is coming. Explore the savage wilderness of the broken planet ICARUS in this PvE survival game for up to eight players. Forge your base, craft high-tech gear, hunt dangerous creatures, tame mounts and extract valuable exotic matter from a hostile world.

Console dropship inbound — now targeting PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series. Gear up for next-gen survival when ICARUS arrives on console.

Available now on PC. Wishlist today.
